text: Implemented checked tabulate plus explicit tabulateMasked; bounded fromWords to expected+1 values; added RVPK version 1 big-endian bytes with explicit word/bit/tail rules and checked decoding; replaced callback combination with specialized union/intersection/difference/xor loops. Shared tests cover B1/B2/B4, views, scalar/empty shapes, exact platform bytes, malformed lengths/metadata, every width's tail bits, and bounded iterators. Evidence: packedJVM 26/26, packedJS 24/24, fmtCheck and docsCheck green; JVM word loops were 6-13x faster than Boolean expansion with output-only allocation.
